name: Anchor Bar & Grill
description: Anchor Bar & Grill is a unique and popular restaurant and pub in Superior, Wisconsin, known for serving the best burgers and fries around. Featured on the TV show Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives, this iconic dive bar offers a variety of homemade burgers and fresh-cut fries at great prices. The walls are covered with nautical memorabilia and artifacts. The restaurant features a game room and outdoor seating. Founded over 20 years ago, it's a must-visit destination in the Superior area.
